Repetition-loop detection: regex backreference (.{20,}?)\1{4,} (a >=20-char unit repeated >=5x contiguously) applied to the last 600 chars of each raw response body. Garbage gate per cell: parse_failures <= 2/43 AND repetition_flags == 0.
